task_summary: Parse FJSP instance data with downtime/policy constraints, generate an optimized feasible schedule with minimal makespan respecting machine downtimes and policy budgets, and output as JSON and CSV.
decomposition_rationale: The task naturally separates into three concerns: (1) parsing heterogeneous input formats into unified data structures, (2) core scheduling algorithms with downtime-aware feasibility logic and policy budget enforcement, and (3) validation and output formatting. This decomposition keeps I/O, computation, and verification cleanly separated.

skills.name: evo-fjsp-data-io
skills.description: Parses all input data files (FJSP instance.txt, downtime.csv, policy.json, baseline schedule CSV) into standardized Python data structures, and exports final schedules to JSON and CSV formats.
skills.responsibility: All file I/O: reading instance definitions, downtime windows, policy budgets, baseline schedules; writing solution.json and schedule.csv with proper type handling (numpy int64 serialization).

skills.name: evo-fjsp-scheduler
skills.description: Core scheduling engine implementing downtime-aware earliest-start computation, greedy dispatching, baseline repair with policy budget enforcement, and simulated annealing optimization for FJSP.
skills.responsibility: All scheduling computation: finding earliest feasible start times considering downtimes, greedy constructive heuristics (ECT), constraint-based schedule repair respecting policy budgets, simulated annealing local search optimization, and schedule decoding from OS/MS representations.
dr_sections: 9. Best Pure-Python Approaches (Within 15 Min Compute Budget)

skills.name: evo-fjsp-validator
skills.description: Validates generated schedules for full FJSP feasibility: operation completeness, precedence constraints, machine eligibility, duration correctness, machine non-overlap, and downtime non-overlap.
skills.responsibility: Post-hoc schedule validation ensuring all hard constraints are satisfied before output. Checks completeness, precedence, machine capacity, duration correctness, downtime compliance, and makespan calculation.
